verdict.rationale: A published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions for a SaaS work-management product like ClickUp, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an uptime SLA, availability commitments, a status page or incident reporting. The real-time references (Slack updates, chat, Brain²) are about task collaboration, not service status.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
